pages.text: The $(bold)Manual Grinder$() is an early-game hand tool for grinding items without any RF power.$(br)$(br)$(bold)How to use:$() Put the Manual Grinder and the item to grind together in a crafting grid (shapeless). The grinder durability decreases with use.$(br)$(br)$(bold)What it grinds:$()$(br)• Any Strain Bud → 1 Weed (half the output of the machine Grinder)$(br)• Hemp Leaf → Hemp Fibers$(br)$(br)$(bold)Note:$() The machine $(bold)Grinder$() outputs 2 weed per bud. Switch to it as soon as you have the materials to double your yield.
